x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change bodies-member-profile-and-voting-record (REQ-MPR-002, REQ-MPR-005, matrix rows bod-05, vot-18, pub-14). A membership carries the subjects the member holds in that body, and a body decides whether its members' votes are published by name.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: The subjects the member holds in this body, such as an alderman's Finance and Housing. It belongs to the membership, not the person: the same alderman holds nothing in the council.

publishVotingRecords.title: Publish voting records
publishVotingRecords.description: Whether the public ORI API publishes the votes of this body's members by name, for rounds that were not secret on published decisions. A council's votes are public by law, a supervisory board's are not.
